paragraphs.en: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体工具包：统一 LLM API、智能体循环、TUI、编码智能体 CLI

paragraphs.en: New issues and PRs from new contributors are auto-closed by default. Maintainers review auto-closed issues daily. See CONTRIBUTING.md .
paragraphs.zh: 新贡献者提交的新议题（issue）和拉取请求（PR）默认会被自动关闭。 维护者每天审核被自动关闭的议题。参见 CONTRIBUTING.md。

sents.en: New issues and PRs from new contributors are auto-closed by default.
sents.zh: 新贡献者提交的新议题（issue）和拉取请求（PR）默认会被自动关闭。

sents.en: Maintainers review auto-closed issues daily. See CONTRIBUTING.md .
sents.zh: 维护者每天审核被自动关闭的议题。参见 CONTRIBUTING.md。

paragraphs.en: Pi is a minimal, extensible agent harness that you can make your own.
paragraphs.zh: Pi 是一个极简、可扩展的智能体框架，你可以将其打造为自己的工具。

paragraphs.en: Adapt Pi to your workflows, not the other way around. Customize Pi with extensions , skills , prompt templates , and themes . Bundle them as Pi packages and share via npm or git.
paragraphs.zh: 让 Pi 适应你的工作流程，而不是反过来。 通过扩展、技能、提示词模板和主题来定制 Pi。 将它们打包为 Pi 包，并通过 npm 或 git 分享。

sents.en: Adapt Pi to your workflows, not the other way around.
sents.zh: 让 Pi 适应你的工作流程，而不是反过来。

sents.en: Customize Pi with extensions , skills , prompt templates , and themes .
sents.zh: 通过扩展、技能、提示词模板和主题来定制 Pi。

sents.en: Bundle them as Pi packages and share via npm or git.
sents.zh: 将它们打包为 Pi 包，并通过 npm 或 git 分享。

paragraphs.en: Pi ships with powerful defaults but skips features like sub-agents and plan mode. Ask Pi to build what you want, or install a package that does it your way.
paragraphs.zh: Pi 自带强大的默认配置，但省略了诸如子智能体和计划模式等功能。 让 Pi 构建你想要的功能，或者安装一个符合你使用方式的软件包。

sents.en: Pi ships with powerful defaults but skips features like sub-agents and plan mode.
sents.zh: Pi 自带强大的默认配置，但省略了诸如子智能体和计划模式等功能。

sents.en: Ask Pi to build what you want, or install a package that does it your way.
sents.zh: 让 Pi 构建你想要的功能，或者安装一个符合你使用方式的软件包。

paragraphs.en: Use Pi interactively , automate it in print or JSON mode , control it over RPC , or build apps with the Pi TypeScript SDK . See OpenClaw for a real-world integration.
paragraphs.zh: 以交互方式使用 Pi，以打印或 JSON 模式将其自动化，通过 RPC 控制它，或使用 Pi TypeScript SDK 构建应用。 参见 OpenClaw 了解一个真实世界的集成示例。

sents.en: Use Pi interactively , automate it in print or JSON mode , control it over RPC , or build apps with the Pi TypeScript SDK .
sents.zh: 以交互方式使用 Pi，以打印或 JSON 模式将其自动化，通过 RPC 控制它，或使用 Pi TypeScript SDK 构建应用。

sents.en: See OpenClaw for a real-world integration.
sents.zh: 参见 OpenClaw 了解一个真实世界的集成示例。

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh On Windows:
paragraphs.zh: curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh 在 Windows 上：

paragraphs.en: powershell -c " irm https://pi.dev/install.ps1 | iex " The installer pins all dependencies and updates Pi with pi update . Alternatively, install directly with npm, which does not pin transitive dependencies:
paragraphs.zh: powershell -c " irm https://pi.dev/install.ps1 | iex " 该安装程序会固定所有依赖，并可通过 pi update 更新 Pi。 或者，直接使用 npm 安装，但这种方式不会固定传递依赖：

sents.en: powershell -c " irm https://pi.dev/install.ps1 | iex " The installer pins all dependencies and updates Pi with pi update .
sents.zh: powershell -c " irm https://pi.dev/install.ps1 | iex " 该安装程序会固定所有依赖，并可通过 pi update 更新 Pi。

sents.en: Alternatively, install directly with npm, which does not pin transitive dependencies:
sents.zh: 或者，直接使用 npm 安装，但这种方式不会固定传递依赖：

paragraphs.en: npm install -g --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent Pi requires Node.js 22.19 or newer. The macOS, Linux, and Windows installers can install it if needed. Pi does not require dependency lifecycle scripts for a normal npm installation.
paragraphs.zh: npm install -g --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent Pi 需要 Node.js 22.19 或更高版本。 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 安装程序可以在需要时安装它。 对于正常的 npm 安装，Pi 不需要依赖项的生命周期脚本。

sents.en: npm install -g --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent Pi requires Node.js 22.19 or newer.
sents.zh: npm install -g --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent Pi 需要 Node.js 22.19 或更高版本。

sents.en: The macOS, Linux, and Windows installers can install it if needed.
sents.zh: macOS、Linux 和 Windows 安装程序可以在需要时安装它。

sents.en: Pi does not require dependency lifecycle scripts for a normal npm installation.
sents.zh: 对于正常的 npm 安装，Pi 不需要依赖项的生命周期脚本。

paragraphs.en: Start Pi in the directory where you want it to work:
paragraphs.zh: 在你想让它工作的目录中启动 Pi：

paragraphs.en: cd /path/to/project pi For a built-in AI provider, run /login inside Pi to connect a subscription or API key. Then give Pi a task.
paragraphs.zh: cd /path/to/project pi 对于内置的 AI 提供商，在 Pi 内运行 /login 以连接订阅或 API 密钥。然后给 Pi 下达任务。

paragraphs.en: See the documentation for full setup and usage instructions, or visit pi.dev for demos.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅文档以获取完整的安装和使用说明，或访问 pi.dev 查看演示。

paragraphs.en: nix run github:earendil-works/pi/stable stable points at the latest release. Install it with nix profile add github:earendil-works/pi/stable and update with nix profile upgrade pi . Use a release tag such as github:earendil-works/pi/v1.0.0 to pin a version, or github:earendil-works/pi for unreleased changes on main . Nix builds Pi from source.
paragraphs.zh: nix run github:earendil-works/pi/stable stable 指向最新发布版本。 使用 nix profile add github:earendil-works/pi/stable 安装，并使用 nix profile upgrade pi 更新。 使用发布标签（例如 github:earendil-works/pi/v1.0.0）来固定版本，或使用 github:earendil-works/pi 获取 main 分支上未发布的更改。 Nix 从源码构建 Pi。

sents.en: nix run github:earendil-works/pi/stable stable points at the latest release.
sents.zh: nix run github:earendil-works/pi/stable stable 指向最新发布版本。

sents.en: Install it with nix profile add github:earendil-works/pi/stable and update with nix profile upgrade pi .
sents.zh: 使用 nix profile add github:earendil-works/pi/stable 安装，并使用 nix profile upgrade pi 更新。

sents.en: Use a release tag such as github:earendil-works/pi/v1.0.0 to pin a version, or github:earendil-works/pi for unreleased changes on main .
sents.zh: 使用发布标签（例如 github:earendil-works/pi/v1.0.0）来固定版本，或使用 github:earendil-works/pi 获取 main 分支上未发布的更改。

sents.en: Nix builds Pi from source.

paragraphs.en: Supports ARM64 and x86-64 on Linux and macOS. Use nix build . or nix run . to build or run your checkout.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上支持 ARM64 与 x86-64。 使用 nix build . 或 nix run . 来构建或运行你检出的代码。

sents.en: Supports ARM64 and x86-64 on Linux and macOS.
sents.zh: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上支持 ARM64 与 x86-64。

sents.zh: 使用 nix build . 或 nix run . 来构建或运行你检出的代码。

paragraphs.en: Nix builds are offline, so the bundled model data comes from a pi.dev model catalog revision pinned in nix/model-catalog.json . At runtime, Pi still overlays newer catalog data from pi.dev as usual. The Nix workflow replaces the pin on main when it no longer matches the checkout, for example after a provider is added or gains a new model type. To refresh it by hand:
paragraphs.zh: Nix 构建是离线的，因此打包的模型数据来自 nix/model-catalog.json 中锁定的 pi.dev 模型目录修订版本。 在运行时，Pi 仍会像往常一样从 pi.dev 覆盖加载更新的目录数据。 当锁定的版本与检出内容不再匹配时（例如在新增提供商或提供商新增模型类型之后），Nix 工作流会在 main 分支上替换该锁定版本。若要手动刷新：

sents.zh: Nix 构建是离线的，因此打包的模型数据来自 nix/model-catalog.json 中锁定的 pi.dev 模型目录修订版本。

sents.en: At runtime, Pi still overlays newer catalog data from pi.dev as usual.
sents.zh: 在运行时，Pi 仍会像往常一样从 pi.dev 覆盖加载更新的目录数据。

sents.en: The Nix workflow replaces the pin on main when it no longer matches the checkout, for example after a provider is added or gains a new model type. To refresh it by hand:
sents.zh: 当锁定的版本与检出内容不再匹配时（例如在新增提供商或提供商新增模型类型之后），Nix 工作流会在 main 分支上替换该锁定版本。若要手动刷新：

paragraphs.en: npm run update:model-catalog-pin Packages This monorepo contains the Pi CLI and its supporting libraries.
paragraphs.zh: npm run update:model-catalog-pin 软件包 本 monorepo 包含 Pi CLI 及其支持库。

paragraphs.en: For Slack/chat automation and workflows see earendil-works/pi-chat .
paragraphs.zh: 关于 Slack/聊天自动化与工作流，请参阅 earendil-works/pi-chat。

paragraphs.en: Pi does not include a built-in permission system for restricting filesystem, process, network, or credential access. By default, it runs with the permissions of the user and process that launched it.
paragraphs.zh: Pi 没有内置的权限系统来限制文件系统、进程、网络或凭据访问。 默认情况下，它以启动它的用户和进程的权限运行。

sents.zh: Pi 没有内置的权限系统来限制文件系统、进程、网络或凭据访问。

sents.en: By default, it runs with the permissions of the user and process that launched it.
sents.zh: 默认情况下，它以启动它的用户和进程的权限运行。

paragraphs.en: npm install --ignore-scripts # Install all dependencies without running lifecycle scripts npm run build # Refresh model data, then build all packages npm run build:offline # Rebuild using existing model data without network access npm run check # Lint, format, and type check ./test.sh # Run tests (skips LLM-dependent tests without API keys) ./pi-test.sh # Run pi from sources (can be run from any directory) Using local packages outside the monorepo Build every public package into one coherent local artifact set:
paragraphs.zh: npm install --ignore-scripts # 安装所有依赖，不运行生命周期脚本 npm run build # 刷新模型数据，然后构建所有包 npm run build:offline # 使用现有模型数据离线重新构建，无需网络访问 npm run check # 进行代码检查、格式化和类型检查 ./test.sh # 运行测试（没有 API 密钥时跳过依赖 LLM 的测试） ./pi-test.sh # 从源码运行 pi（可在任意目录中运行） 在 monorepo 之外使用本地包 将每个公共包构建为一套连贯的本地工件集合：

paragraphs.en: npm run pack:packages -- --out .artifacts/pi-packages This refreshes model data before building pi-ai . To avoid network access when model data is already hydrated, pass --offline-model-data .
paragraphs.zh: npm run pack:packages -- --out .artifacts/pi-packages 此命令会在构建 pi-ai 之前刷新模型数据。 若模型数据已就绪且希望避免访问网络，请传入 --offline-model-data 。

sents.en: npm run pack:packages -- --out .artifacts/pi-packages This refreshes model data before building pi-ai .
sents.zh: npm run pack:packages -- --out .artifacts/pi-packages 此命令会在构建 pi-ai 之前刷新模型数据。

sents.en: To avoid network access when model data is already hydrated, pass --offline-model-data .
sents.zh: 若模型数据已就绪且希望避免访问网络，请传入 --offline-model-data 。

paragraphs.en: Then configure an external project to consume one package and resolve all of its Pi dependencies from the same artifact set. npm is the default:
paragraphs.zh: 然后配置一个外部项目来使用其中一个包，并从同一组构件中解析其所有 Pi 依赖项。npm 是默认选项：

paragraphs.en: node scripts/use-local-packages.mjs \ --manifest .artifacts/pi-packages/manifest.json \ --consumer ../my-project \ --package @earendil-works/pi-durable \ --package @earendil-works/pi-agent-core cd ../my-project npm install --ignore-scripts For a pnpm project, point --consumer at the workspace root:
paragraphs.zh: node scripts/use-local-packages.mjs \ --manifest .artifacts/pi-packages/manifest.json \ --consumer ../my-project \ --package @earendil-works/pi-durable \ --package @earendil-works/pi-agent-core cd ../my-project npm install --ignore-scripts 对于 pnpm 项目，请将 --consumer 指向工作区根目录：

paragraphs.en: node scripts/use-local-packages.mjs \ --manifest .artifacts/pi-packages/manifest.json \ --consumer ../my-project \ --package @earendil-works/pi-agent-core \ --package-manager pnpm cd ../my-project pnpm install --ignore-scripts Repeat --package for each direct dependency. The command updates the consumer's package.json with content-addressed local file: references. It writes transitive overrides to package.json for npm or pnpm-workspace.yaml for pnpm. Keep the artifact directory available while installing or updating the consumer. Re-run both commands after changing Pi source.
paragraphs.zh: node scripts/use-local-packages.mjs \ --manifest .artifacts/pi-packages/manifest.json \ --consumer ../my-project \ --package @earendil-works/pi-agent-core \ --package-manager pnpm cd ../my-project pnpm install --ignore-scripts 对每个直接依赖重复使用 --package 参数。 该命令会以基于内容寻址的本地 file: 引用来更新使用方的 package.json。 对于 npm，它会将传递依赖的 overrides 写入 package.json；对于 pnpm，则写入 pnpm-workspace.yaml。 在安装或更新使用方期间，请保持制品目录可用。 修改 Pi 源码后，请重新运行这两条命令。

sents.en: node scripts/use-local-packages.mjs \ --manifest .artifacts/pi-packages/manifest.json \ --consumer ../my-project \ --package @earendil-works/pi-agent-core \ --package-manager pnpm cd ../my-project pnpm install --ignore-scripts Repeat --package for each direct dependency.
sents.zh: node scripts/use-local-packages.mjs \ --manifest .artifacts/pi-packages/manifest.json \ --consumer ../my-project \ --package @earendil-works/pi-agent-core \ --package-manager pnpm cd ../my-project pnpm install --ignore-scripts 对每个直接依赖重复使用 --package 参数。

sents.en: The command updates the consumer's package.json with content-addressed local file: references.
sents.zh: 该命令会以基于内容寻址的本地 file: 引用来更新使用方的 package.json。

sents.en: It writes transitive overrides to package.json for npm or pnpm-workspace.yaml for pnpm.
sents.zh: 对于 npm，它会将传递依赖的 overrides 写入 package.json；对于 pnpm，则写入 pnpm-workspace.yaml。

sents.en: Keep the artifact directory available while installing or updating the consumer.
sents.zh: 在安装或更新使用方期间，请保持制品目录可用。

sents.en: Re-run both commands after changing Pi source.
sents.zh: 修改 Pi 源码后，请重新运行这两条命令。

paragraphs.en: GitHub releases include a versioned source archive covered by the release's SHA256SUMS file. Extract it and run the same build script used for the official standalone binaries:
paragraphs.zh: GitHub 发布版本包含一个由该发布版本的 SHA256SUMS 文件覆盖校验的带版本号的源代码归档。 解压它并运行与官方独立二进制文件所用的相同的构建脚本：

sents.en: GitHub releases include a versioned source archive covered by the release's SHA256SUMS file.
sents.zh: GitHub 发布版本包含一个由该发布版本的 SHA256SUMS 文件覆盖校验的带版本号的源代码归档。

sents.en: Extract it and run the same build script used for the official standalone binaries:
sents.zh: 解压它并运行与官方独立二进制文件所用的相同的构建脚本：

paragraphs.en: VERSION= " <release-version> " tar -xzf " pi- ${VERSION} -source.tar.gz " cd " pi- ${VERSION} " ./scripts/build-binaries.sh --offline-model-data --platform linux-x64 --out " $PWD /out " The archive includes release model data and native prebuilds. --offline-model-data uses that model data without refreshing provider catalogs. The script installs dependencies and builds the executable with its runtime assets; pass --skip-install if dependencies are already provided.
paragraphs.zh: VERSION="<release-version>" tar -xzf "pi-${VERSION}-source.tar.gz" cd "pi-${VERSION}" ./scripts/build-binaries.sh --offline-model-data --platform linux-x64 --out "$PWD/out" 该压缩包包含发布版模型数据和原生预构建文件。--offline-model-data 使用这些模型数据，而不刷新提供商目录。 该脚本会安装依赖并使用其运行时资源构建可执行文件；如果依赖已就绪，可传入 --skip-install。

sents.en: VERSION= " <release-version> " tar -xzf " pi- ${VERSION} -source.tar.gz " cd " pi- ${VERSION} " ./scripts/build-binaries.sh --offline-model-data --platform linux-x64 --out " $PWD /out " The archive includes release model data and native prebuilds. --offline-model-data uses that model data without refreshing provider catalogs.
sents.zh: VERSION="<release-version>" tar -xzf "pi-${VERSION}-source.tar.gz" cd "pi-${VERSION}" ./scripts/build-binaries.sh --offline-model-data --platform linux-x64 --out "$PWD/out" 该压缩包包含发布版模型数据和原生预构建文件。--offline-model-data 使用这些模型数据，而不刷新提供商目录。

sents.en: The script installs dependencies and builds the executable with its runtime assets; pass --skip-install if dependencies are already provided.
sents.zh: 该脚本会安装依赖并使用其运行时资源构建可执行文件；如果依赖已就绪，可传入 --skip-install。

paragraphs.en: We treat npm dependency changes as reviewed code changes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 npm 依赖变更视为经过审查的代码变更。

paragraphs.en: If you use Pi or other coding agents for open source work, please share your sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你使用 Pi 或其他编程智能体进行开源工作，请分享你的会话。

paragraphs.en: Public OSS session data helps improve coding agents with real-world tasks, tool use, failures, and fixes instead of toy benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 公开的 OSS 会话数据有助于用真实世界的任务、工具使用、失败与修复来改进智能体，而非使用玩具基准。

paragraphs.en: For the full explanation, see this post on X .
paragraphs.zh: 如需完整说明，请参阅 X 上的这篇帖子。
